_comment: Named DPYD panel presets. Published specifications only; see 'source' on each.

cpic4.label: CPIC 4-variant DPYD panel (reaches HapB3 via the tag SNP)
cpic4.source: CPIC DPYD guideline (PMID 29152729) four-variant actionable set; reaches HapB3 via the tag SNP rs56038477.

cpic4_plus_sas.label: CPIC 4-variant panel + 4 star alleles CPIC and the DPWG both call normal function (no added actionable coverage)
cpic4_plus_sas.source: cpic4 plus four star alleles CPIC and the DPWG both assign normal function. Adds no actionable coverage; retained because naming a diplotype requires the star alleles that define it.

cpic4_causal.label: CPIC 4-variant panel + the causal HapB3 variant c.1129-5923C>G
cpic4_causal.source: cpic4 plus the causal HapB3 variant c.1129-5923C>G (rs75017182); the only preset able to separate a true HapB3 carrier from a tag-only positive.

amp_tier1.label: AMP/ACMG 2024 Tier 1 must-test set — all seven variants
amp_tier1.source: AMP/ACMG/CPIC/CAP/DPWG/ESPT/PharmGKB/PharmVar joint consensus 2024 (PMID 39032821), Tier 1 must-test DPYD variants.

full.label: All 32 DPYD loci defined in the bundled allele table
full.source: Every DPYD locus the reference allele table defines. Upper bound, not a commercial assay.
